title: Co-insure
tagline: A peer insurance product for nomads who face uncertainties during travelling.
description:
The concept of Co-insure is designed to address the uncertainties faced by
participants in digital nomad communities, crypto conference communities and pop-up city movement during their travels, encompassing concerns related to safety, health, and unforeseen events.

Traditional insurance processes are often slow and mired in ambiguous
terminology, leading to frustration.

Understanding the challenges people encounter when dealing with
unexpected events, the idea behind Co-insure is to create a platform where
individuals can mutually insure each other based on trust within a group and
customized governance structures.
how_its_made: This project uses the Celo Minipay  Opera Brower based wallet behind the scene to connect to Gnosis Safe and Snapshot APIs. We used Figma to design the front end and the back end is still being built in Node.js. This project is still under development because my colleague is ill.
